plan.title: WGCNA co-expression modules vs case-control status
plan.analytical_narrative: The cohort is 60 cases vs 60 controls, unpaired, single batch, whole-blood bulk RNA-seq delivered as gene-level Salmon counts (12,000 genes x 120 samples) with metadata holding only sample ID and condition. The question is which co-expression modules the genes form across all 120 samples and which of those modules track case versus control status. WGCNA requires a variance-stabilized, low-count-filtered expression matrix, so the flow is: (1) blind vst QC to verify sample structure and flag outliers before any network is built; (2) filterByExpr filtering against the condition groups to remove genes with no worthwhile counts, which otherwise distort correlation structure; (3) a signed WGCNA network on the variance-stabilized, filtered matrix with soft-threshold selection by scale-free fit, topological-overlap dynamic tree cut, module eigengenes, and eigengene-vs-condition correlation to answer which modules track status; (4) a report carrying module sizes, gene-to-module assignments, hub genes by kME, and eigengene-trait correlations with p-values adjusted across the module x trait test count. Because the Salmon import state is not recorded as length-corrected, all steps consume raw counts and let DESeq2's vst handle normalization rather than importing any abundance-scale table.

steps.method: DESeq2 blind variance stabilizing transform + PCA on top 500 variable genes + sample distance heatmap
WGCNA signed network with soft-threshold selection, TOM dynamic tree cut, module eigengenes, eigengene-trait correlation
